This policy applies to every zone of the city and sets the risk index bands used by the duty officer.

## 1 Purpose

The policy defines the landslide index and flood index bands that trigger monitoring, warnings and protective
actions across the city. It binds the Disaster Cell, the roads department and the drainage board.

## 4.1 Risk index bands

The landslide index enters the watch band at 0.40, the warning band at 0.60 and the critical band at 0.80.
The flood index enters the watch band at 0.35, the warning band at 0.55 and the critical band at 0.75.
Band changes are recorded with the sensor readings that produced them.

## 4.2 Slope construction halt rule

Excavation on any slope steeper than 25 degrees must halt when soil saturation exceeds 0.70 or when the zone
is in the warning band or higher. The halt stays in force until the zone returns to the normal band for
twelve hours and an engineering inspection clears the site.

## 5 Public alert levels

Alerts are issued at three levels: advisory, warning and evacuate. An evacuate alert always requires approval
by the duty officer and is broadcast on every channel.
